whatIs.title: What is hydrolipoclasia?
whatIs.p1: Hydrolipoclasia is a non-invasive body treatment designed to help reduce localized fat and improve body contour through specialized protocols that combine different technologies and aesthetic techniques.
whatIs.p2: This treatment is usually applied in areas where fat tends to accumulate and is difficult to reduce through diet or exercise alone.
whatIs.important: It is important to understand that:
importantItems: It does not substitute healthy habits

who.title: For whom is this treatment recommended?
items: Want to improve their body contour
Seek to reduce localized fat accumulations
Wish to complement exercise and healthy eating
Seek to visually improve certain areas of the body
who.frustrationTitle: If you feel like you are making efforts and yet there are areas that don't change… you are not alone.
who.frustrationLabel: Many people come to MJ frustrated because:
frustrations: “I exercise and my abdomen doesn't go down”
“My waist doesn't improve even if I take care of myself”
“I feel accumulation on flanks or back”
“I want to look better without surgery”
who.frustrationNote: And that's precisely where a professional assessment can help you discover the right protocol for your body.

howItWorks.title: How does a hydrolipoclasia session work?

steps.d: We analyze goals, areas, habits and type of accumulation to give you personalized recommendations.
The treatment is performed according to the area and specific need of your body.
Depending on the case, additional protocols may be recommended to boost results.
We guide you on hydration, nutrition, physical activity and aftercare.

includes.title: What it includes
items: Lymphatic drainage or ultrasound (depending on case)
includes.note: * Results and number of sessions vary by individual.

sessions.title: How many sessions are recommended?
sessions.desc: The number of sessions depends on the treated area, your body goal, personal habits, professional assessment and your body's individual response.
sessions.quote: "Many people observe progressive changes as sessions progress and they maintain healthy habits."
